purpose: Test whether a causal close-confirmed market-structure transition that creates a same-direction three-candle fair-value gap, followed by the first later midpoint-confirmed retest, can time the next 30 seconds better than the retired oscillator/channel families.
independence: Entry requires swing-structure break + same-break-bar FVG + later retest/rejection.

public_logic_sources.source: MetaQuotes MQL5 Article 18669 — Fair Value Gaps, Breakers and Market Structure Shifts
public_logic_sources.disclosed_logic: Three-candle FVG/imbalance, market-structure shift from breaking the last high/low, lower-timeframe scalping sequence, and GOLD emphasis.

public_logic_sources.source: MetaQuotes Code Base 74575 — Market Structure SMC
public_logic_sources.disclosed_logic: N-bar fractal swings, close-confirmed BOS/CHoCH, standard three-candle FVGs.

public_logic_sources.source: TradingView — Fair Value Gap Strategy with Break of Structure Confirmation
public_logic_sources.disclosed_logic: Bullish FVG when candle-1 high is below candle-3 low, bearish inverse; FVG conditioned on confirmed structure break.
Closed-candle structure shift, imbalance/FVG after fast directional move, retrace into FVG for continuation.

structure_semantics.swing: symmetric two-bar confirmed swing high/low (five-bar fractal), revealed only after two right-side completed bars
structure_semantics.structure_break: completed Bid-bar close beyond latest revealed swing; each swing identity breaks once
structure_semantics.classification: CHOCH if break side opposes previous confirmed structure-break side; BOS if it agrees; initial unclassified break establishes state only
structure_semantics.fvg: same completed structure-break bar must form standard three-candle same-direction gap
structure_semantics.retest: first later completed bar overlapping gap and closing back through its 50% consequent-encroachment midpoint in structural direction
structure_semantics.invalidation: full close through far FVG boundary, opposite structure break, or newer same-side qualifying event
structure_semantics.proposal_timing: first executable tick at or after completed retest-bar right edge

R037-MSF-C01_M1_CHOCH_FVG_RETEST.trigger: same-break-bar bullish/bearish FVG then first later midpoint-confirmed retest

R037-MSF-C02_M1_BOS_FVG_RETEST.trigger: same-break-bar bullish/bearish FVG then first later midpoint-confirmed retest

execution.proposal_entry: first executable tick at/after completed retest bar edge
execution.candidate_rearm: one proposal per armed structure/FVG event; consumed on first confirmed retest

screen_gate.winner_or_quality_gate: official-win delta nonnegative OR positive net with improved gross loss

forbidden: FVG midpoint/retest rule tuning after result
